pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on opening secondary positions within 300 seconds of an existing open position unless existing trade is at least +$5.00 in floating profit with stop moved to Breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Pre-trade hard rejection if calculated stop-loss distance exceeds 50 pips ($5.00 per 0.01 lot XAUUSD) or if 1-minute ATR is > 3.0 USD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Activate aggressive trailing stop at +$3.00 unrealized profit to secure 60% of peak float; auto-close 100% on reversal sentinel trigger at +$10.00+.
